title: Revelation, the Clear Book, and Riding Animals

paragraphs.text: Allah does not speak to any human being except through revelation, from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger who reveals by His permission what He wills; He is Most High and Wise. In this way, Allah revealed to the Prophet an inspiration by His command. Before it, he did not know what the Book or faith was, but Allah made it a light to guide whom He wills, and the Prophet guides to a straight path: the path of Allah, who owns everything in the heavens and the earth. All matters return to Him.

A new surah begins with Ha, Meem, and an oath by the clear Book. Allah made it an Arabic Qur'an so that people might understand, and in the Mother of the Book it is high and full of wisdom. Should Allah stop sending the reminder just because people go beyond limits? Many prophets were sent to earlier peoples, but every one of them was mocked. Allah destroyed nations far more powerful than these, and the example of the earlier peoples has already passed.

If they are asked who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely say the Exalted in Might, the Knowing. He made the earth a resting place and laid out roads on it so people can find their way. He sends rain from the sky in measured amounts and brings dead land back to life; in the same way, people will be brought forth. He created all the kinds of creatures, and He made ships and animals for people to ride. When they sit on them, they should remember their Lord's favor and say: Exalted is He who made this serve us, because we could not have controlled it ourselves, and to our Lord we will surely return. Yet people have given Him a share from among His own servants, and humans are clearly ungrateful.
